Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 10: the slip of [[Keder The Black (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“While at Senate: Sidious is politics +3; "senators" on Squabbling Delegates is treated as "Coruscant Guards;" and may lose 1 Force to place Keder and an opponent's [Coruscant] Political Effect (or [Coruscant] senator here) in owner's Lost Pile.”), word for word the text of [[Keder The Black (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
